messages:
mike_customer: Hey team — promo code REDWOOD-TRIAL-50 applied to our account but we don't see credits available for Dedicated reserved capacity. Billing UI shows it under 'Private'. We're trying to provision reserved GPUs for a load test tomorrow. account: acct_9b2f, region: us-west-2. Can someone check?
jess_support: Sorry about that, Mike. Can you paste the exact promo code and a screenshot of the billing line? Also, which SKU was it meant for (dedicated-std / dedicated-pro / hosted)?
mike_customer: Code = REDWOOD-TRIAL-50. Intended for dedicated-std commit. Screenshot: https://redwood.screenshots/clip/abc123 (can't attach from mobile). We're blocked from creating capacity because the promo only shows up under Private credits.
alex_billing: Heads up — promo codes are SKU/product-scoped. Looks like this one was configured to product: private-deployment instead of dedicated. I'll pull the backend mapping. @jess_support if you want to open a finance escalation I'll coordinate.
jess_support: Opening finance escalation now. @billing-bot fetch promo-info REDWOOD-TRIAL-50
billing-bot: Promo REDWOOD-TRIAL-50 | amount: $50 | product: private | sku: private-std | expires: 2026-06-30 | applied_to: acct_9b2f
alex_billing: Confirmed. That's why it isn't reachable by Dedicated allocation flows. We can reassign, but best practice is to create a new dedicated-scoped promo and apply credit to the account rather than editing historical promo entries.
nisha_sre: +1 — don't mutate historical applied_to fields; create new credit mapping so logs & audit trail remain intact. After applying new promo, validate Dedicated UI and the reserved capacity API responses include the credit.
alex_billing: Plan: 1) create new promo via AdminUI / Promotions (type=credit, amount=50, product=dedicated, sku=dedicated-std, expires=same) 2) apply to acct_9b2f 3) invalidate original REDWOOD-TRIAL-50 4) post note on billing ticket. Doing step 1 now.
alex_billing: Created new promo REDWOOD-DED-50 and applying to acct_9b2f...
billing-bot: Promo REDWOOD-DED-50 created | product: dedicated | sku: dedicated-std | amount: $50 | status: applied to acct_9b2f
mike_customer: I can already see "Reserved credits: $50" in the Dedicated UI credit balance. Trying to create a dedicated capacity reservation now.
mike_customer: Creating capacity succeeded — prompts accepted and provisioning started. Looks good from my side. Thanks!
jess_support: Great — marking escalation resolved on support ticket. @alex_billing can you confirm old promo invalidated and leave audit note?
alex_billing: Old promo REDWOOD-TRIAL-50 invalidated. Action recorded: `POST /admin/promos/invalidations {"code":"REDWOOD-TRIAL-50","reason":"reassigned_to_dedicated","actor":"alex_billing"}`. Billing ticket #BILL-4821 updated with both promo ids and explanation.
mike_customer: Really appreciate the fast turnaround :pray:
jess_support: Closing thread — reach out if anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
